page_data.en:
REVISED STATISTICS OF LABOUR MOVEMENTS
IN SHANGHAI ( 1-10-26 )

There are 28 defects in the activities of
the past. Fresh statistics are to be compiled.
The defects in the past have first to be pointed
out in detail. What we have already found out
are as follows:-
(1) There are many persons in charge of
the activities but they are all incompetent. As
a result of this, there are always too many men,
yet work is being done inefficiently and disorder
prevails in the end.
(2) Owing to lack of funds those in charge
of the labour movement have to spend most of their
time in raising money, thus depriving them of time
to be devoted to proper work.
(3) The majority of the officers in charge
of the movement are in want of statistics; they
are also insincere and in some cases deceive
others by purposely delaying work and refusing to
act on the initiative. When forwarding reports
to their superiors, they are in the habit of
exaggerating their reports which therefore do not
tally with the true circumstances. Thus various
defects creep in.
(4) The work is not being properly divided;
some have too much to do, while others have too
little to handle. There is also a lack of proper
direction, resulting in labourers trying to shift
the work to others.
(5) The appointment of a small number of
people to handle the affairs of the labour union
would tend to check the activities of labour
organizations.
(6) The officials of labour associations
should not be allowed to make use of the influence
of the labour organizations.
(7) There is a lack of understanding
between the officials of the labour association
and the mass of the people.
(8) There is a lack of definite statistics
relating to activities carried out.
(9) The labour union is much too slack in
the mediation of disputes between capitalists and
labourers.
(10) Lack of attention to the leaders of
the mass of people.
(11) Lack of good understanding of the
strength of the opponents.
(12) The holding of meetings irregularly
with no record of matters discussed and failure
to enforce the resolutions passed and late
attendance at meetings.
(13) Failure to send in reports in due time.
(14) Lack of physical training of leaders.
(15) The inefficiency of the propaganda
work due to lack of proper articles published at
belated hours and the irregular issuing of
articles.
(16) Lack of encouragement to workers.
(17) Corruption in educational activities.
(18) Lack of attention in the undertaking of
any work.
(19) Lack of financial demands being put
forward.
(20) Lack of proper scrutinization (? of
labour conditions).
page_data.zh:
上海劳工运动修订统计数据（1926年10月1日）

过去的活动中存在28项缺陷。需编制新的统计数据。首先必须详细指出过去的缺陷。我们已查明的情况如下：
(1) 负责活动的人员众多，但均不称职。因此，人员总是过多，然而工作效率低下，最终导致混乱局面。
(2) 由于缺乏资金，劳工运动的负责人不得不将大部分时间用于筹款，从而剥夺了他们从事正当工作的时间。
(3) 大多数运动负责人缺乏统计数据；他们也不真诚，在某些情况下故意拖延工作并拒绝主动采取行动，以此欺骗他人。在向上级提交报告时，他们习惯于夸大其词，因此报告与真实情况不符。由此产生了各种缺陷。
(4) 工作分配不当；有些人工作量过大，而其他人则无事可做。同时也缺乏适当的指导，导致工人试图将工作推给他人。
(5) 任命少数人处理工会事务，往往会抑制劳工组织的活动。
(6) 不应允许劳工协会的官员利用劳工组织的影响力。
(7) 劳工协会官员与广大群众之间缺乏了解。
(8) 缺乏关于开展活动的确切统计数据。
(9) 工会在调解资本家与工人之间的纠纷方面过于松懈。
(10) 对群众领袖缺乏关注。
(11) 对对手的实力缺乏良好了解。
(12) 会议不定期举行，无讨论事项记录，未能执行通过的决议，且出席会议迟到。
(13) 未能及时提交报告。
(14) 对领袖缺乏体能训练。
(15) 宣传工作效率低下，原因是发布的文章不当、发布时间滞后以及发文不定期。
(16) 缺乏对工人的鼓励。
(17) 教育活动中的腐败现象。
(18) 在开展任何工作时缺乏重视。
(19) 缺乏提出的财务要求。
(20) 缺乏对劳工状况的适当审查（原文不清）。

page_data.en:
(21) Lack of knowledge of the general demands of
labourers resulting in non-uniformity of demands
presented on each occasion.
(22) Lack of true facts to prove the sufferings of
labourers.
(23) Lack of funds to be supplied by a higher
labour organization and the assault of labourers without
any causes.
(24) The way negotiations are conducted is improper.
(25) The activities are not systematically directed.
(26) Failure to make use of the labour unions which
have in consequence become an individual organ.
(27) Too much respect is paid to mere forms.
(28) Failure of branch labour parties to function
in the mills.
The following are the points which call
for special attention:-
(1) To make the labour association adaptable
to all classes of people. Before the 1st. Anniversary
of the May 30 incident we had fully realized that the
labour union can not be made adaptable to all classes
of people. The recent strike of labourers in the
employ of the Japanese cotton mills in the Ferry Road
district proves the statement. This strike was conducted
in a very poor manner. We are thus convinced that the
labour union can not be adapted to all classes of people.
(2) Certain labour leaders are interfering between
labourers and the officers of the higher organs, thus the
nature of a labour union is not known to the public and the
labour union can not secure any genuine support from
labourers. This is an obstruction to the labour movement.
Therefore from now on all these vices should be done away
with and the labour union should be made adaptable to the
general public.
(3) The foundation of the labour movement in
Shanghai is based on the mills workers and printers.
Our influence has not been extended to wharf coolies,
seamen, postmen, railway coolies and other labourers in
cities and towns. Henceforth special attention should
be paid to these classes of labourers, so as to render
the labour movement in Shanghai effective.
(4) In the past we have not been able to carry
out our activities owing to certain circumstances. But
at present we are finding it possible to advance in our
activities, particularly in regard to printers, postmen,
workers in the employ of iron works and cotton mills.
Our work is to give education to labourers and to improve
the living conditions of labourers in Shanghai. In the
past our work among mill workers was not at all successful.
Hereafter attention should be paid to these labourers so
as to have full control over them.
(5) All those officers of the Association who
can be spared should no longer be engaged in order to
cut down expenses. Pay days should be fixed. The
general committee should be restored and should hold
meetings on certain definite dates. The duty of the
general committee should be received. A general meeting
should be held within the next three months and meetings
of other committees should be held either monthly or
weekly.
(6) The department of organization should draw up
a list of labour organizations and issue a circular
explaining the organization of labour associations.
page_data.zh:
(21) 不了解工人的一般需求，导致每次提出的要求不一致。
(22) 缺乏证明工人苦难的真实事实。
(23) 缺乏来自上级劳工组织的资金支持，以及无故殴打工人。
(24) 谈判方式进行不当。
(25) 活动缺乏系统性的指导。
(26) 未能利用工会，致使工会 consequently 成为个人机构。
(27) 过分注重形式。
(28) 支部劳工党派未能在工厂中发挥作用。
以下是需要特别关注的要点：
(1) 使劳工协会适应各阶层人士。在五卅惨案一周年之前，我们已充分认识到工会无法适应各阶层人士。近期渡轮路地区日本棉纺厂雇员的罢工证明了这一说法。这次罢工进行得非常糟糕。因此我们确信，工会无法适应各阶层人士。
(2) 某些劳工领袖在工人与上级机关官员之间进行干涉，因此公众不了解工会的性质，工会也无法获得工人的真正支持。这是劳工运动的障碍。因此，从现在起应消除所有这些弊病，使工会适应广大公众。
(3) 上海劳工运动的基础建立在工厂工人和印刷工人之上。我们的影响力尚未扩展到码头苦力、海员、邮递员、铁路苦力以及其他城镇劳动者。今后应特别注意这些阶层的劳动者，以使上海的劳工运动行之有效。
(4) 过去由于某些情况，我们未能开展活动。但目前我们发现有可能推进我们的活动，特别是在印刷工人、邮递员、铁厂雇员和棉纺厂工人方面。我们的工作是对工人进行教育，并改善上海工人的生活条件。过去我们在工厂工人中的工作毫无成效。此后应注意这些工人，以便完全控制他们。
(5) 为了削减开支，不再留用协会所有可裁减的官员。应固定发薪日。应恢复总委员会，并在确定的日期举行会议。总委员会的职责应予明确。应在未来三个月内召开一次全体会议，其他委员会的会议应每月或每周举行。
(6) 组织部应起草劳工组织名单，并发布通告解释劳工协会的组织结构。

page_data.en:
7.- The Propaganda Committee of the Shanghai
General Labour Union should be reorganized and
the following three new methods of propaganda
should be adopted:-
1. Propaganda by means of songs and ballads;
2. Propaganda by means of rumours which should
be disseminated in teashops;
3. Propaganda by means of slogans and humorous
sketches which should be done with chalk
and charcoal at places where labourers
congregate.

8.- A general investigation lasting a period of
two weeks.

9.- An examination into the work of the labour
unions should be held and should last two weeks.
Comments should be made upon the work of the
labour union which should be also properly guided.

10.- Improvements should be made in all publications
which must be issued at regular intervals.

11.- The Shanghai General Labour Union should
open a "News Auditing Department" for the
purpose of collecting news items from various
labour unions to be published, examining and
publishing them. This step is essential in order
to adopt an unanimous attitude towards the outsiders
and to increase the efficacy of the propaganda
work. .

12.- Investigation forms should be prepared with
the object of ascertaining the strength of enemy
forces and the special character of the labour
districts. These should be filled in at regular
intervals by the persons responsible for the
respective labour districts in order to decide
upon the time and plans of struggles.

13.- Strict attention should be paid to the living
conditions of the labourers. This can be done by
inquiring into the amount of income and expenditure
of the workers' families consisting of one, two,
three and four persons respectively engaged in
every kind of industry. In order to obtain
accurate results, four or five families should be
selected from each of the above mentioned categories.

14.- The Shanghai General Labour Union will
conduct a subscription campaign within a period
of three months.

15.- The Five-Day Publication will be priced
instead of being distributed free of charge.

II. Representative Labour Unions.

16.- As many conferences as possible should be
held by labour masses with the direct partici-
pation of representatives from the Shanghai
General Labour Union.

17.- The propaganda department should prepare
a system of subject matters for these conferences
designed for the training of workers. These
page_data.zh:
7.- 上海总工会宣传委员会应改组，并采取以下三种新的宣传方法：
1. 通过歌曲和歌谣进行宣传；
2. 通过在茶馆散布谣言进行宣传；
3. 通过在工人聚集的地方用粉笔和木炭书写标语和幽默漫画进行宣传。

8.- 为期两周的全面调查。

9.- 应对工会工作进行为期两周的检查。应对工会工作发表评论，并给予适当指导。

10.- 所有出版物均应改进，并必须定期发行。

11.- 上海总工会应设立“新闻审核部”，目的是从各个工会收集新闻稿件，进行审核并发布。这一步骤对于对外采取统一态度和提高宣传工作效率至关重要。

12.- 应准备调查表格，目的是查明敌对势力的实力和劳工区的特殊性。这些表格应由各劳工区的负责人定期填写，以决定斗争的时间和计划。

13.- 应密切关注工人的生活条件。这可以通过调查从事各类行业的一人、二人、三人和四人家庭的收支金额来实现。为了获得准确的结果，应从上述每类家庭中选取四到五个家庭。

14.- 上海总工会将在三个月内开展募捐活动。

15.- 《五日刊》将定价出售，而非免费分发。

II. 代表性工会。

16.- 应在上海总工会代表直接参与的情况下，尽可能多地由劳工群众召开会议。

17.- 宣传部应为这些旨在培训工人的会议准备一套议题。这些

page_data.en:
matters should be prepared at certain intervals
each month.

18.- In order thoroughly to understand the
demands of the labour masses and to maintain
close contact with them, the Shanghai General
Labour Union will open an office where delibera-
tions may be held with the leaders of workers
from all factories.

19.- Model labour unions should be established
in labour centres.

III. Constructive Works.

20.- Within the period of one month, the
Shanghai General Labour Union should devise
a plan for the establishment of Model Labour
Unions, which should be subsequently adopted
for purposes of trial by all labour unions.

21.- The executive committee of each labour
union should be given six hours' training
(?daily) to teach them their work in a
systematical way.

22.- Plans should be devised and regulations drawn
up for the establishment of labourers' clubs,
Consumers' co-operative society, sick and
unemployment insurance societies, public mess
halls and "Buying and Selling Stores". The
foregoing schemes should be first tried by
printers, postal and telegraph workers.

23.- A liberal educational conference should be
summoned with the persons responsible for the
following institutions participating in it:-
Schools under control of labour unions,
Proletarian schools and Labourers' Clubs.
Educational plans should be first drawn up by
persons responsible for the guidance of these
institutions to be submitted to the conference.

24.- The Printers' General Union, the Silk
Filature Workers' Union, the Manual Workers'
Union, the Seamen's Union, the Cotton Mill
Workers' Unions, the Shop Assistants Unions,
and the Postal and Telegraph Workers' Unions
should, within a period of three months,
contrive to secure financial independence,
reduce the allowance which they have been
receiving from the Shanghai General Labour
Union, and gradually find their own sources of
income and to defray all expenses. They
should also prepare and announce their budgets
to enable the workers to realize the financial
conditions of their unions,

25.- As soon as a labour union has been
inaugurated, the organization committee should
be abolished, and in its place a permanent
committee or permanent officers should be
installed.

26.- The Picketing System should be abolished and
a "Labourers' Service Corps" should be formed.
page_data.zh:
议题应每月按一定间隔时间准备。

18.- 为了彻底了解劳工群众的需求并与他们保持密切联系，上海总工会将开设一个办事处，以便与各工厂的工人领袖进行商议。

19.- 应在劳工中心建立模范工会。

III. 建设工作。

20.- 在一个月内，上海总工会应制定建立模范工会的计划，随后供所有工会试用。

21.- 每个工会的执行委员会应接受六小时的培训（每日？），以系统地教导他们的工作。

22.- 应制定计划和规章，以建立工人俱乐部、消费合作社、疾病和失业保险社、公共食堂以及“买卖商店”。上述方案应首先在印刷工人、邮政和电报工人中试行。

23.- 应召开自由教育会议，下列机构的负责人应参加会议：
工会控制的学校、
无产阶级学校和工人俱乐部。
教育计划应首先由负责指导这些机构的人员起草，并提交会议审议。

24.- 印刷业总工会、缫丝工人工会、手工工人工会、海员工会、棉纺厂工人工会、店员公会以及邮政和电报工人工会，应在三个月内设法实现财政独立，减少从上海总工会获得的津贴，并逐渐寻找自己的收入来源以支付所有费用。他们还应编制并公布预算，使工人了解其工会的财务状况，

25.- 一旦工会成立，即应撤销组织委员会，取而代之的是设立常设委员会或常任职员。

26.- 应废除纠察队制度，组建“工人服务团”。

page_data.en:
27.- All labour unions should be directed to
draft within two weeks practical plans (for the
Labourers' Service Corps?)

28.- Ten to twenty female workers should be
selected in each labour district and should be
secretly and strictly trained to become leaders.

IV. Work under New Environments.

29.- During the current month special attention
should be paid to the work of organizing postal
and telegraph workers, seamen, wharf coolies,
railway workers, shop assistants, etc. so as to
create a new phase in the labour movement.
The scheme is as follows:-
(1) Reorganization of Seamen's Union and re-election
of its executive committee. Force should be used
to stop loafers from committing riotous acts.
The union and club should be maintained independent
of each other. The organization of branches of
the union for ships crews, launch crews and
cargo boatmen should be improved. Co-operation
should be instituted with shipping companies
whose ships ply between Shanghai, Hankow, Tientsin
and Canton, an organization for crews of river
ships should be formed, and conferences and
dinner parties should be held in honour of outport
seamen who visit Shanghai.

(2) The Wharf Coolies' General Union should
gradually abolish the "old fashioned" leaders of
wharf coolies, and co-operate with members of
various factions of wharf employees. Wharf coolies
should be secretly organized and persons should
be specially trained to take up this work.

(3) The Postal Employees Union should preserve
its status after its re-organization. Strenuous
efforts should be made to develop the school for
Yu-Lu-Sheng and to form an organization exclusively
for postmen.

(4) Efforts should be made to carry out amusement,
educational and economic enterprises for
electrical and tramway employees and attention
should be paid to the work of uniting them in the
common cause.

(5) Coal workers, masons and carpenters should
be organized and preparations should be made to
launch a general attack upon Tung Li Chang and
Hsu Wei San in the tenth moon in order to eliminate
their influence amongst the manual workers.

(6) As regards shop assistants, more attention
should be devoted to the General Goods Shop
Employees Union, and prepare for an economic
struggle in the twelfth moon.

(7) Railway work. Capable persons should be
selected to undertake the development of railway
work at Woosung. Organization of the railway
workers in the North and South Stations
should also be commenced.
page_data.zh:
27.- 应指示所有工会在两周内起草切实可行的计划（针对劳工服务团？）。

28.- 每个劳工区应选拔十至二十名女工，并对她们进行秘密而严格的训练，使其成为领袖。

四、新环境下的工作。

29.- 本月应特别注意组织邮政和电报工人、海员、码头苦力、铁路工人、店员等的工作，以开创劳工运动的新局面。方案如下：-
(1) 改组海员工会并重新选举其执行委员会。应采取强制手段制止游手好闲者从事暴乱行为。工会与俱乐部应保持相互独立。应完善针对轮船船员、小轮船员和驳船船夫的工会分支机构的组织。应与在上海、汉口、天津和广州之间航行的航运公司建立合作，组建内河船舶船员组织，并举行会议和晚宴，以款待访问上海的外埠海员。

(2) 码头苦力总工会应逐步废除码头苦力中“老式”的把头，并与码头雇员各派系的成员合作。应秘密组织码头苦力，并专门培训人员来承担这项工作。

(3) 邮务员工工会在改组后应保持其地位。应大力努力发展余路生（Yu-Lu-Sheng，音译）学校，并组建一个专门由邮递员组成的组织。

(4) 应努力为电气和有轨电车员工开展娱乐、教育和经济事业，并注意将他们团结在共同事业中的工作。

(5) 应组织煤炭工人、泥瓦匠和木匠，并准备在农历十月对童礼昌（Tung Li Chang，音译）和徐维三（Hsu Wei San，音译）发动全面攻击，以消除他们在体力劳动者中的影响。

(6) 关于店员，应更多地关注百货店员工总工会，并为农历十二月的经济斗争做好准备。

(7) 铁路工作。应选派能干的人员负责开展吴淞的铁路工作。还应开始组织北站和南站的铁路工人。

page_data.en:
30.- As regards workers in the other trades,
their present influence should be preserved.
However new leaders should be found to take up
the work of re-organizing the unions of workers
in the Siao So T'u district, and ways and
means should be devised to find situations for
unemployed workers. A conference should be
held of persons responsible for the mill workers'
movement in Yangtszepoo, Ying-Hsiang-Kong,
Pootung, Zau-Ka-Doo, etc. within the shortest possible
period in order to discuss the adoption of a definite
scheme either for preserving present conditions or
for suitable development. In addition to carrying
on the constructive work amongst the printers,
precaution should be taken against the possibility
of their going over to the "Right" section.

V. The Party's Work in the Labour Unions.

31.- The secret Shanghai General Labour Union
is in other words the office of "Chu Wei"
(Two characters whose meaning cannot be defined).
The Party's representatives will be responsible
for the labour movement in the various labour
districts, but all decisions of the policy and
plans of the labour movement must be approved by
the district offices which are responsible to the
Board of Chairmen of such offices. The Party's
Secretary also acts as the representative of the
Shanghai General Labour Union.

32.- The Party's branches in the factories shall
have control over the labour unions, and the
responsible officers of the labour unions shall be
made members of the Party's branches. The Party's
branches shall decide upon the policy, etc. of
the labour union's activities and vigorously
supervise all students participating in the labour
movement.

30.- 关于其他行业的工人，应保持他们目前的影响力。然而，应寻找新的领导人来承担重组小沙渡（Siao So T'u）地区工人工会的工作，并设法为失业工人谋取职位。应在尽可能短的时间内召开杨树浦、引翔港（Ying-Hsiang-Kong，音译）、浦东、曹家渡（Zau-Ka-Doo，音译）等地负责纱厂工人运动的人员会议，以讨论采取明确方案，无论是维持现状还是进行适当发展。除了在印刷工人中开展建设性工作外，还应警惕他们转向“右”派的可能性。

五、党在工会中的工作。

31.- 秘密的上海总工会即是“Chu Wei”（二字含义无法确定）办事处。党的代表将负责各个劳工区的劳工运动，但劳工运动的所有政策和计划决策必须经由各区办事处批准，这些办事处向各办事处主席团负责。党的书记也兼任上海总工会的代表。

32.- 工厂中的党支部应控制工会，工会的负责官员应成为党支部的成员。党支部应决定工会活动的政策等，并严厉监督所有参与劳工运动的学生。
